red_blue.label: Red / Blue
useful_notes: Harder early route because Brock resists Fire.
Becomes much stronger once it has better coverage and evolves.
Good Speed makes it comfortable for regular trainer battles.

yellow.label: Yellow
yellow.availability: Gift on Route 24 from a trainer north of Cerulean City.
useful_notes: Useful against Grass, Bug and Ice Pokemon.
Needs help against Rock, Ground and Water Pokemon.

ruby_sapphire_emerald.label: Ruby / Sapphire / Emerald
ruby_sapphire_emerald.availability: Not normally available in Hoenn without trade or event transfer.
useful_notes: If traded in, it is a fast offensive Fire option.
Charizard gains strong mixed coverage later.
Be careful around Rock moves because of Charizard's double weakness after evolving.
